images.caption: A village Padangbai (Q1910262), in Karangasem Regency, south-eastern Bali, Indonesia. It includes four beaches and several diving spots, in particular the Blue Lagoon sites which have become part of a Marine Protected Area in 2017 along with Bias Tugal Beach. Starting in 2019, hexagonal steel structures coated with resin and sand, anchored on the seabed close together to maximize coral density and fasten the colonization process.
images.alt: A village Padangbai (Q1910262), in Karangasem Regency, south-eastern Bali, Indonesia. It includes four beaches and several diving spots, in particular the Blue Lagoon sites which have become part of a Marine Protected Area in 2017 along with Bias Tugal Beach.
